Chapter 6344: Kneel

Chapter 6344: Kneel

“Murderous intent? You think too highly of yourself and your branch. There’s no murderous intent when crushing insects.” Li Qiye didn’t bother gazing in the direction of Centurial Peak as he spoke.

His merciless words suffocated listeners. The disdainful tone made them think of him as being unbeatable. Tenth-gen Chen was comparable to Everlasting Jiang yet he was only an insect?

Could he flatten the Chen effortlessly despite their numerous masters and resources? Everlasting Jiang and Wisdom Ancestor lacked the power to do so.

The members of the Chen were furious at his attitude.

“Ancestor, do you wish to declare war on Centurial Peak and push us off the cliff?” The ancient voice turned cold: “For generations, our members spilled blood and lost their lives for Desolate Frontier. Our legacy cannot be erased by your words alone. We will not hand over our resources. Your insistence will cause a rift bringing an end to Desolate Frontier...”

His retort echoed across Desolate Frontier. Many agreed with him, even those from the other branches.

A fight between the ancient ancestors was beyond their level. Protectors and elders weren’t allowed to comment. Nevertheless, some found logic in his statement.

The Chen occupied nearly half of Desolate Frontier. They have been here for so long and were a part of the foundation. An all-out war could lead to sect destruction.

“Threatening me now?” Li Qiye smiled: “With your words alone, I would have been merciful just eradicating your direct bloodline. Today, since I’m feeling rather benevolent, just taking your fortunes is the greatest of kindness.”

“We deserve our fortune and resources!” Ten-realm Emperor shouted.

“Kneel.” Li Qiye stood up and his eyes turned cold.

“Bam!” Ten-realm dropped to his knees, unable to struggle against Li Qiye’s will.

“Ten-realm!” Goldclad and Lostmetal tried to help him only to be suppressed all the same.

“You will spill blood now, Ancestor?” Tenth-gen Chen spoke again.

“Shut up.” Li Qiye said and the silence power intensified, preventing him from speaking again.

“Today, I seize the fortunes of the Chen. Centurial will not be theirs any longer.” Li Qiye declared as he gazed at the crowd, freezing them in place.

Now, he finally gave the feeling of being a supreme ancestor.

“Boom!” He raised his hand and the immortal peak became resplendent. It spewed out an immortal inferno, far beyond what the crowd had seen.

Everyone dropped to the ground as if their progenitor was returning. They also willingly prostrated during this monumental event.

“Rumble!” The main mountains of Desolate Frontier harmonized with the flames.

The grand momentum of Desolate Frontier activated as well, seemingly to greet the return of the progenitor. Dao laws appeared everywhere to form the momentum’s outline.

The main arrays include the twelve main peaks, serving to fuse the momentum with the earth and its chaos true energy. Emperors were as insignificant as dust compared to this majestic entity.

“The progenitor!” Top members shouted after seeing the momentum created by the progenitor. This was the strongest ace card of their sect.

However, no one could use it before. Even Everlasting Jiang only had access to one part, not the whole thing.

Li Qiye, on the other hand, activated all of it. The twelve peaks were within his grasp.

“The Chen’s branch shall return to regularity.” Li Qiye chanted a mantra.

“Boom!” Lost, River, and Centurial Peak erupted with chaos true energy, worldly energy, dao power...

The Chen had at least one-third of Desolate Frontier’s territory and earth veins. Thus, when everything erupted, it resulted in a magnificent energy accumulation.
